statement: Current hid-playstation requests DS4 USB feature 0x12/16-byte pairing info to derive MAC; BT uses HIDP's uniq string. Failure of required identity acquisition aborts probe, unlike firmware 0xA3.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 2148–2175 and 2784–2789; host protocol expectation not a retail pairing dump.
